Make risk information meaningful Are you an analytical risk professional who can bring structure to complex information, ask the right questions and convert findings into clear, decision-useful outputs? KPMG Jamaica Extended Support Services (KJESS) is seeking an Enterprise & Operations Risk Analyst to support enterprise and operations risk activities for its Client, KPMG United States. This role provides exposure to risk assessments, enterprise risk reporting, risk registers, treatment plans, risk indicators, management reporting, process improvement and special projects. You will work closely with onshore risk professionals and other stakeholders, applying practical risk management experience, analytical judgement and strong coordination skills. Success in this role requires initiative, attention to detail, thoughtful follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities in an evolving risk environment. What you will do Risk assessment delivery Collaborate with the onshore Risk Assessment Capability Team and relevant stakeholders to support the design and execution of risk assessments using the firm’s approved methodology. Coordinate and participate in interviews, workshops and working meetings, including preparing agendas, presentation materials, meeting notes and follow-up actions. Review and synthesize qualitative and quantitative information to support risk identification, assessment, prioritization, evaluation and response planning. Use approved templates and AI-enabled tools to prepare and refine project charters, risk registers, risk profiles, analyses, treatment plans and leadership-ready presentations. Conduct research and benchmarking against relevant frameworks, leading practices and regulatory expectations, where applicable. Develop and maintain project plans that support effective resource planning and timely delivery. Support the development and maintenance of enterprise risk registers, risk profiles, risk taxonomies, key risk indicators, mitigation actions and treatment plans. Collect, validate, reconcile, organize and analyze risk information from approved sources. Develop and maintain dashboards, analytical workbooks, reports, registers and presentations for management and committee decision-making. Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, duplication and emerging patterns, and coordinate the clarification or correction of identified issues. Perform quality reviews of source data, calculations, narrative updates and supporting documentation before submission for Client approval. Support the design, documentation and operation of manual and IT-enabled or automated Enterprise Risk Management Systems of Quality Control controls. Assist with quarterly control-operator attestations relating to control performance and effectiveness. Identify opportunities to improve team processes, templates, tools and technology. Test tools under development and provide feedback on functionality and usability. Maintain shared mailboxes, portals, SharePoint sites, Teams channels, calendars, trackers, repositories and access records. Support project and pipeline reporting and the development of materials for leadership presentations, stakeholder training and onsite workshops. Ensure that work products and supporting information are maintained in approved Client repositories and handled in accordance with applicable information protection requirements. Serve as a knowledgeable point of contact for service delivery matters. Build productive relationships across KJESS and Client teams. Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, clarify expectations and manage upward through practical recommendations and timely follow-through. Proactively identify and escalate issues affecting scope, quality, capacity, data availability or delivery timelines, and recommend corrective action. Adapt your support as the Client’s priorities, methodologies, systems and risk landscape evolve. A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university. A concentration in risk management, accounting, auditing, finance, economics, statistics, business, information systems or a related discipline is preferred. Substantial relevant experience may demonstrate equivalent capability. A minimum of three years of relevant experience in enterprise or operations risk management, internal or external audit, risk advisory, regulatory or compliance services, or a related professional-services environment. Experience developing or reviewing risk assessments, risk registers, risk reports, mitigation plans, management presentations or comparable decision-support deliverables. The ability to interpret complex or incomplete information, ask effective questions, exercise sound judgement and produce clear recommendations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, communication and stakeholder management skills. The ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation and deliver high-quality work within deadlines. Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with data analysis, reporting, visualization, process improvement or workflow automation. Experience with Power BI, ServiceNow or comparable platforms. Relevant certification or advanced study in internal audit, risk management, business continuity, project management, data analytics or a related field. Familiarity with generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or Google Gemini, including the ability to develop and refine prompts, assess outputs and adapt the tools for different work activities. Clear and effective communication Strong customer service and accountability for quality Collaboration and teamwork Credible stakeholder management Continuous improvement Objective data gathering and analysis A commitment to quality Structured problem-solving Effective project management Enterprise risk reporting and insights Controls, technology and project support Stakeholder relationship management What you bring Added advantages How you will succeed Working with KJESS KJESS operates a hybrid work model. Employees may work from home in Jamaica or from the office and are required to work from the office for at least five days each month, with additional in-office days where required by business needs. The role operates in a fast-paced, primarily paperless environment and requires the use of information systems throughout the workday. Employees are expected to use KPMG-approved generative AI tools in support of their daily responsibilities. Periodic extended hours or work on public holidays may be required.
